6.1.5. What to do if "In Control" but Unacceptable?

the average level is too high or too low or the variability is unacceptable?
experiments calibration re-analysis of historical database can be initiated to put the process on target or reduce the variability.
the process must be stable before it can be centered at a target value or its overall variation can be reduced.
